target: Next calendar day valid accelerometer-algorithm sleep wear minutes <420; not main-night sleep, diagnosis, current health or psychological state
source: CDC NHANES 2011-2012 and 2013-2014 PAXDAY plus DEMO
population: Age>=18; adults only; age80 is top-coded
history: Up to three consecutive completed QC-passing days ending at day d; target d+1 must pass same QC. At least one history day. Never future sleep, activity, demographics, participant id or cycle as predictor.

split.unit: participant SEQN; all records of a person in same partition

selection: Highest validation macro F1, then balanced accuracy, then prefer logistic and decision threshold nearest0.5; no test metrics select model or hyperparameters
fairness: RIAGENDR1=Male,2=Female; age groups18-29,30-44,45-59,60+; known metadata only, excluded predictor. Share frozen IDs and target with assignment2.
test_policy: After validation selection freeze one configuration per learned family; report both and both simple baselines once on same test. Subsequent fairness experiment is predefined comparison, not further selection on test.
uncertainty: Model output is uncalibrated score. Validation reliability and test Brier reported; do not present calibrated probability or certainty. Near threshold display uncertainty as explicit heuristic.
deployment: Prototype manual sleep-history input and validation-record replay. HealthKit-to-ActiGraph transfer and device capture not validated. No claim of current health inference.

bootstrap.metric: accuracy and paired accuracy gain over persistence
